aztec-gods.title: The 12 Aztec / Mexica gods — the Tenochtitlán pantheon · the first pre-Columbian pantheon on gab44 · source-honest from the Florentine Codex · gab44 ✨
anchors: Meet the 12 Aztec gods → ⛩ Shinto Kami — the 12 deities of the Japanese pantheon The ninth great pantheon — and the first East Asian pantheon on gab44, closing the geographic gap of East Asia. Uniquely among great-world-pantheons, the only one that is still the state-recognized national-cultic system of a contemporary G7 country (~80,000 active Shinto shrines across Japan, ~3% identify as Shintoist but ~70% participate in at least one annual Shinto ritual). Three families. Celestial / Amatsukami (sun-gold / storm-cobalt / moon-silver / dawn-rose): Amaterasu the sun-goddess and ancestress of the imperial-line whose Ise Naikū has been rebuilt every 20 years for 1,300 years in the Shikinen Sengū continuity; Susanoo the storm-and-sea brother whose Yamata-no-Orochi slaying at the Hi River in Izumo produced the Kusanagi sword; Tsukuyomi the silent mysterious moon-brother whose Ukemochi-slaying ended cosmic sun-moon co-presence; Ame-no-Uzume the dawn-dancer whose ecstatic dance on the overturned tub at the heavenly-river-bed lured Amaterasu out of the Iwato rock-cave — the foundational performing-arts narrative of every kagura, gigaku, bugaku, noh, kabuki, and butoh. Earthly / Kunitsukami (earth-brown / vermillion-fox / forest-stag / dragon-blue): Ōkuninushi great-land-master of Izumo and kami of enmusubi-binding-of-all-relationships, host of the annual October Kamiari-conference at Izumo Taisha; Inari rice-and-fox-kami of ~32,000 of Japan's ~80,000 shrines (the most-numerous single kami), patron of Fushimi Inari Taisha with its iconic 10,000+ vermillion torii; Sarutahiko the great earthly-kami who met Ninigi at the Eight-Crossroads-of-Heaven and was disarmed by Uzume's laughing-grin; Watatsumi the dragon-king of the underwater Ryūgū-jō Dragon-Palace, source of the two cosmic-tide-jewels and cosmic-maternal-grandfather of the imperial-line via Toyotama-hime. Syncretic / Shinbutsu (warrior-purple / Sarasvatī-pearl / fisherman-coral / cherry-blossom-pink): Hachiman the warrior-Bodhisattva of ~25,000 shrines, the first kami granted the Buddhist title Daibosatsu in 749 CE inaugurating the honji-suijaku synthesis, patron of the Minamoto samurai and the Kamakura shogunate; Benzaiten the Indian-Vedic Sarasvatī arrived via the Sutra of Golden Light and fully-Japanized as the only female of the Seven Lucky Gods; Ebisu the only-fully-Japanese member of the Seven Lucky Gods, originally the rejected leech-child Hiruko cast out to sea and cosmic-rehabilitated as the laughing-fisherman-luck-kami; Konohana-no-Sakuya-hime the cherry-blossom-and-Mount-Fuji princess and cosmic-foundational figure of mono no aware (the cosmic-aesthetic of the pathos of ephemeral things). Kojiki (712 CE) / Nihon Shoki (720 CE) / Engishiki (927 CE) / Fudoki / Norito / Manyōshū / Motoori-Norinaga / Hardacre source-honest. Shadow-honest about the 1868 Meiji Shinbutsu-bunri separation that destroyed the 1,200-year-old Buddhist-Shinto honji-suijaku synthesis, State Shinto 1868-1945, the imperial-divinity-myth and Yasukuni-controversy, the Lafcadio-Hearn / Joseph-Campbell Western reductions to "nature-religion," and the post-Studio-Ghibli kami-as-anime-spirits flattening.

mesopotamian-gods.title: The 12 Mesopotamian gods — the Sumerian-Akkadian-Babylonian pantheon · the OLDEST written religion · source of zodiac and the 7 classical planets · gab44 ✨
anchors: Meet the 12 Mesopotamian gods → 🪶 Aztec / Mexica Gods — the 12 deities of Tenochtitlán The eighth great pantheon — and the first pre-Columbian pantheon on gab44, closing the geographic gap of the Americas. The youngest fully-documented great pantheon (Tenochtitlán 1325-1521 CE, less than 200 years of imperial-cult-practice but inheriting a millennium of pre-Mexica Mesoamerican religion from the Olmecs c. 1200 BCE, Teotihuacan c. 100-650 CE, and the Toltecs c. 950-1150 CE) — and the only one with first-generation conquistador-and-friar ethnography (Bernardino de Sahagún interviewed surviving Mexica elders in Nahuatl in the 1550s-1580s and the 12-book Florentine Codex is the result). Three families. Primordial & Cosmic (cosmic-violet / quetzal-jade / smoking-obsidian / Fifth-Sun-coral): Ometeotl the cosmic-dual-principle of Omeyocan-the-thirteenth-heaven invoked only in the philosophical-poetry of the tlamatinime; Quetzalcoatl the feathered-serpent civilizer-priest-king whose return-prophecy Moctezuma II mistook for Cortés in 1519 — the single-most-politically-consequential religious-mistake in world history; Tezcatlipoca the smoking-mirror trickster-fate-god whose Toxcatl-festival was the site of Pedro de Alvarado's 1520 massacre; Tonatiuh the Fifth-Sun whose Calendar Stone is the single-most-iconic Mexica sculpture. Earth, Water & Fertility (storm-jaguar-blue / jade-river-teal / serpent-skirt-forest / cherry-cosmic-pink): Tlaloc the goggle-eyed storm-god with iconography unchanged from Teotihuacan c. 100 CE through 1521; Chalchiuhtlicue the jade-skirted lady-of-all-surface-water whose baptism-rite became Catholic baptism in unbroken continuity; Coatlicue the serpent-skirted earth-mother whose Coatlicue-Monolith was twice-buried by 18th-c. antiquarians as too-frightening; Xochiquetzal the flower-quetzal goddess of beauty, art, the in-xochitl-in-cuicatl flower-and-song aesthetic. War, Death & Renewal (Mexica-blue / Mictlan-violet / Xipe-crimson / cosmic-Milky-Way): Huitzilopochtli the Hummingbird-of-the-Left whose eagle-on-the-cactus-with-the-snake omen is still the Mexican flag five centuries after conquest; Mictlantecuhtli the skeletal king of Mictlan whose Hueymiccailhuitl is the direct ancestor of the modern Day-of-the-Dead; Xipe Totec the Flayed Lord of agricultural-spring-renewal whose maize-seed-cosmology-applied-to-the-human-warrior-body is the most-philosophically-difficult Mexica ritual; Mixcoatl the Cloud-Serpent of the Milky-Way and cosmic-father of the Chichimec-hunter-lineage. Florentine-Codex / Codex-Borgia / Leyenda-de-los-Soles / Cantares-Mexicanos source-honest. Shadow-honest about Cortés 1519-1521, Landa's auto-da-fé 1562, the Black Legend, the Mexicayotl revival, the Penacho de Moctezuma repatriation dispute, and the 2017-2020 tzompantli skull-rack archaeological reinterpretations.

anchors: Meet the 12 Olympians → ⚔️ Greek Heroes — the 12 mortals who walked the threshold The companion funnel to the Olympians — where the Olympians are immortal sovereigns, the heroes are the mortals who walked between human and divine. Three families. Strongmen (bronze-gold): Heracles the lion-skinned twelve-labored bastard-of-Zeus deified at Mount Oeta, Theseus the Minotaur-slayer who forgot to change the black sail and founded Athens by synoikismos, Perseus the Medusa-slayer-by-mirror-shield and founder of Mycenae, Bellerophon the Pegasus-rider who flew too close to Olympus and wandered the Aleian plain eating his own soul. Cunning Wanderers (wine-purple): Odysseus the polytropos "of many turns" who came home to Ithaca disguised as a beggar after twenty years, Jason the Argonaut-leader who won the Fleece only through Medea's magic and died asleep under his own rotting Argo, Cadmus the Phoenician prince sent to find Europa who founded Thebes instead and brought the alphabet to Greece, Achilles the half-divine warrior whose mēnis opens the Iliad and whose grief at Patroclus' death converted to apocalyptic rage. Threshold Crossers (twilight-violet): Orpheus the singer who descended alive to Hades and lost Eurydice by glancing back one step too soon, Asclepius the founder of medicine who raised the dead and was struck by Zeus' thunderbolt for upsetting the cosmic-order, Atalanta the bear-mother-raised huntress beaten only by Hippomenes' three golden apples, Hippolyta the Amazon queen whose destruction is depicted on the Parthenon itself. Shadow-honest about Disney/Marvel sanitization, gym-bro Heracles commodification, Pre-Raphaelite eroticization, Cixous-Medusa re-reading, Atwood-Penelopiad re-reading, the unread Amazonomachy-on-the-Parthenon, Bellerophon's suppressed cautionary-tale-of-pride, the Achilles-Patroclus love-relationship recovered from Victorian-suppression. Astral court (sun-gold / moon-silver / Venus-rose / city-purple): Shamash / Utu sun-judge under whose patronage Hammurabi received the Code, Sin / Nanna moon-king whose Lament for Ur is the oldest preserved city-elegy, Inanna / Ishtar the Descent-to-the-Underworld goddess whose three-days-on-the-hook predates Christ by 2,000 years, Marduk Babylon's patron who killed Tiamat and built the cosmos from her body. Underworld & specialists (war-red / scribe-indigo / hunter-bronze / queen-obsidian): Nergal plague-and-war king of Kutha, Nabu the scribal Lord of Ezida at Borsippa whose name became the Hebrew nāḇîʾ "prophet" (Mount Nebo), Ninurta hunter-warrior of the Anzu-Bird-slaying epic, Ereshkigal queen of the underworld and Inanna's elder sister. Enuma-Elish, Gilgamesh, Descent-of-Inanna, Atra-Hasis, Hammurabi, Enheduanna, MUL.APIN source-honest. Biblical-extraction-honest: Atra-Hasis→Noah, Hammurabi→Mosaic law, Nabu→nāḇîʾ, Inanna→Marian Queen-of-Heaven, three-days-on-the-hook→resurrection. shinto-kami.title: The 12 Shinto kami — the Japanese pantheon · the first East Asian pantheon on gab44 · source-honest from the Kojiki (712 CE) and Nihon Shoki (720 CE) · gab44 ✨
anchors: Meet the 12 Shinto kami → 🐉 Chinese Deities — the 12 of the Daoist · Buddhist · folk pantheon The tenth great pantheon — and the most-populous pantheon by living adherents (~300-400M Chinese folk-religion practitioners plus the transnational Mazu, Guanyin, and Guan Yu diaspora cults across Taiwan, Hong Kong, Singapore, Malaysia, and Chinatowns worldwide). The only pantheon that survived a state-sponsored Cultural-Revolution destruction (1966-1976, ~70-90% of Buddhist and Daoist temples destroyed) and a contemporary Sinicization-of-religion (中国化) campaign under Xi Jinping (2015-). The pantheon that integrates Daoism, Buddhism, Confucian ancestor-veneration, and folk religion into the unique San Jiao (三教 "Three Teachings") syncretism — and the pantheon whose celestial bureaucracy literally mirrors the imperial Chinese administration (ministries, vice-ministers, demotions, promotions, paper joss-money memos, an annual kǎohé performance-review of every god). Three families. Celestial Sovereigns (imperial-gold / peach-purple / cosmic-chaos / serpent-rose): Yu-Huang / Jade Emperor the supreme bureaucratic sovereign whose 9th-day-of-1st-lunar-month Bài Tiān Gōng birthday is the largest annual religious holiday in Hokkien Taiwan and the Chinese diaspora; Xi-Wang-Mu / Queen Mother of the West the primordial pre-cosmic goddess of Mount Kunlun with her peach-of-immortality (蟠桃) grove; Pangu the cosmic giant who emerged from the primordial chaos-egg and separated heaven from earth over 18,000 years before his body became the world; Nüwa the serpent-bodied creator who shaped humanity from yellow clay and patched the broken sky with five-colored stones. Compassion, Earth & Scholar (lotus-blue / scholar-cobalt / earth-tan / wealth-gold): Guanyin the bodhisattva of compassion — the Chinese gender-flip of Avalokiteśvara, the single most-worshipped female deity on Earth; Wenchang Wang the patron of literature and the imperial-examination (科举) system that organized Chinese civil-service for 1,300 years (605-1905 CE); Tu Di Gong the local-earth-god of every neighborhood, the most-omnipresent deity in Chinese folk religion with shrines on every street corner from Taipei to San Francisco Chinatown; Caishen the god of wealth whose 5th-day-of-new-year firecracker-welcoming is the most-performed annual religious act in the Chinese-speaking world. Warriors, Trickster & Underworld (loyalty-red / monkey-orange / hell-violet / sea-cyan): Guan Yu the Three Kingdoms general deified as god of loyalty, brotherhood, business — the most-paradoxical deity-cult in the modern world, worshipped simultaneously by Hong Kong police AND Hong Kong triads; Sun Wukong the Monkey King of Journey to the West (1592), arguably the most-adapted character in world literature (1,000+ adaptations including Goku, Naruto bunshin, Avatar airbending, Marvel Shang-Chi, Black Myth: Wukong); Yan Wang king of the Ten Courts of Hell, the Indian-Vedic Yama-Rāja syncretized with Chinese-Daoist underworld bureaucracy; Mazu the goddess of the sea (~5,000 temples worldwide, ~100M+ devotees, UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage 2009 — the Dajia Mazu 9-day pilgrimage in Taiwan attracts ~1M participants annually). Daodejing / Zhuangzi / Shanhaijing / Lotus Sutra / Romance of the Three Kingdoms / Journey to the West / Investiture of the Gods / Yuli Baochao / Mazu annals source-honest. Shadow-honest about the Cultural-Revolution temple-destruction, the Xi-Jinping Sinicization campaign, the Falun-Gong suppression, the 19th-c. Orientalist construction of "Chinese religion," the missionary erasure, the white-New-Age Tao-of-Pooh commodification, the gym-Tai-Chi register, the Mazu Taiwan-vs-mainland political instrumentalization, the Guan-Yu police-and-triads double-worship, and the Disney/Marvel/Dragon-Ball Western flattening.
